title: Presence via a signed bridge heartbeat to the api
summary: POST /api/devices/heartbeat (device-signed, replay-guarded, copying the transport-report pattern) and a status derived from last_seen_at at read time; bridge presence.rs posts every 30 s. Relay's status POST still runs this stage so nothing user-visible changes.

title: Shrink the relay to rendezvous
summary: Delete device_key/device_online/device_offline fan-out, transport_key, and the status POST from the relay and the bridge relay client; frame cap 64 KiB, queue 1 MiB; serve_device/serve_client under the clippy threshold with both ratchets retired; relay tests, dev_relay example and k8s yaml updated.

title: The bridge refuses to be relayed, and signaling is carrier-neutral
summary: session_accept returns over the carrier the session_init arrived on (the seam a direct-network listener reuses); non-rtc.* frames on a Relay carrier are refused with relay_is_not_a_data_plane; FellBack becomes ChannelsLost and the admin bucket relay_only becomes never_connected.

title: Prefer direct: mDNS, interface policy, relay acceptance delay
summary: A SettingEngine on the bridge peer: mDNS QueryOnly so browser host candidates resolve on a LAN, UDP4/UDP6 non-loopback gathering, a relay-pair acceptance delay, BRIDGE_ICE_POLICY=direct-only that strips TURN, and BRIDGE_ICE_INTERFACES; parsed fail-fast with tests.

title: SPA core: the rendezvous seam, one socket for two sessions, no terminal socket
summary: core/rendezvous.js replaces relayLink.js (both ratchets retired): one socket mints the app and terminal sessions with no device_key wait; sessionSwitch makes the peer the only active carrier and queues calls until it arrives; peerLink gains onConnected/onFailed; TerminalSocket is built from a minted session and rides only the term channel.

title: SPA policy: live only over channels, fail closed, presence from the api
summary: connection.js opens rendezvous → mints both sessions → negotiates → closes the socket → live; any failure enters an explicit blocked state with a Retry banner and no relay RPC; presence polls GET /api/devices; device settings sessions ride a channel too; browser pass with Build/spa:verify.

title: QA over the peer path, deploy, docs
summary: A Rust qa_peer example replaces the Node relay-path QA in compose and CI (negotiates through the relay, closes the socket, asserts over the channels, and checks the relay refusal); README, HANDOFF, deploy docs and the older WebRTC spec updated.
